title: User, Robot, Deployer: A New Model for Measuring Trust in HRI
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the concept of "trust" in human-robot interaction. It proposes a new model to better understand and measure trust, which is a fundamental moral and ethical concept governing interactions between agents. The analysis goes beyond technical performance to consider the social and relational aspects that underpin trustworthiness, making it a paper focused on an ethical dimension of HRI.
